column1: # THE JSON SCHEMA VOCABULARIES the importer reads, one per line: the
# vocabulary's URI, the dialect that defines it, whether a schema reads
# it always or only where its meta-schema lists it, the mode its
# `format` keyword takes, and the keywords it defines, space-separated.
# A schema whose meta-schema declares `$vocabulary` reads the keywords
# of the vocabularies listed there, and of the core vocabulary always,
# and takes each other keyword of its dialect as an annotation. A
# vocabulary the meta-schema lists with any value but `false` and this
# table does not hold refuses the schema with `jsonschema_vocabulary`;
# one it lists as `false` is skipped. A meta-schema that declares no
# `$vocabulary` reads every vocabulary of its dialect.
# The format modes: `annotation`, a record on the meta rider;
# `assertion`, a format(g) as well, whether the vocabulary is listed
# as `true` or `false`; `required`, an assertion where the vocabulary is
# listed as `true` and an annotation where it is listed as `false`; `-`,
# no `format` keyword.
# `make vocabularies` stages this table into ts/src/vocabularies.ts and
# go/vocabularies.tsv, and both suites assert each copy is identical.
